full_judgment: 12. We have heard the submissions of the learned Counsel for the petitioners of both leave-petitions and perused the order of the learned Assistant Judge as well as the impugned judgment of the High Court Division. The present two Title Suits are for declaration of title and recovery of Khas possession and the Partition Suit No. 181 of 1984 was filed by one Moslem Uddin Khondoker, are ex facie two different kinds of suit, and there cannot be the same issue in the said suits. It appears that the learned Assistant Judge upon consideration of the materials on record rightly found that the nature and character of the instant Title Suits and the partition Suit No. 181 of 1984 are different in their nature and character and the issues involved therein are also different. In the aforesaid circumstances, we are of the view that an application for stay of the further proceeding of the plaintiff-respondents' two suits till disposal of the partition suit was rightly rejected by the learned Assistant Judge. The High Court Division, in our view, has also taken a correct view agreeing with the findings and decisions arrived at by the learned Assistant Judge.
